core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers a sleek, modern espresso machine with a stainless-steel finish, designed for a café-like experience without requiring professional barista skills. He values ease of use, aesthetic appeal, and a balance between functionality and design.
core_memory.user_interest_steam_wand: Michael is interested in an espresso machine with a steam wand for frothing milk, specifically to make latte or cappuccino-style drinks like strawberry matcha latte at home. He enjoys the idea of hosting friends and replicating coffeehouse-style beverages in his kitchen.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry: Michael wants to know estimated arrival date for espresso machine due to event at end of month. Concerned about out-of-state shipping and delays. Open to expedited shipping if available.
core_memory.user_coffee_grinder_recommendation: Michael wants a coffee grinder that pairs with his espresso machine—sleek, modern, and designed for fresh grinding. He values aesthetics and functionality, and is open to a small investment to enhance his brewing experience.
core_memory.user_lost_package_preparedness: Michael wants to know if the company files carrier claims for lost/damaged packages. He values transparency and wants to be prepared—especially since the machine is a significant personal investment.
core_memory.user_delivery_signature_preference: Michael requires a signature upon delivery to prevent packages from being left in the rain or damaged on the doorstep. He will be available to receive the package in person, especially during rainy weather.
